item.title: [150] GTA VI
item.description:
>The protagonists are the couple Jason and Lucia.
>They need money after a job goes wrong and end up on the run.
>You decide whether they stay as lovers or just partners in crime.
>Building their relationship unlocks things like holding hands and kissing.
>You can freely switch between them, and the one you’re not controlling follows their own daily routine.
>Hideouts feel lived-in with details like proper mug placement, bed covers, and morning coffee.
>The story starts in the Leonida Keys and the map fills in as you explore.
>Gym workouts are a proper mini-game where you can build muscle or get overweight.
>Food gives temporary buffs while training permanently improves your stats.
>The Wanted system is overhauled so you only get stars if someone actually sees the crime.
>A new Criminal Profile tracks whether you play like a professional or a violent thug.
>The world and people react differently based on how aggressive you are.
>You have a bank account and lose all cash if you get wasted or busted.
>Car theft has progression tiers: lockpicks work early, but luxury cars need a key cloner later.
>Fancy cars often have alarms and trackers that can alert the police.
>Regular people can be armed and will fight back against you.
>A new Heat system lets police track you by clothes, car, and weapons.
>You can lose Heat by changing clothes, dumping weapons, or leaving the area.
>Roads are narrower with more realistic traffic and actual jams.

item.title: [ 42] 'Bribery', ‘Vote buying’: Trump's 5k bribery plot to buy off midterms sparks massive backlash
item.description:
President Donald Trump has been accused of bribery and vote buying online after he offered $5000 dividend checks to American adults if Republicans won the midterms.

“I will give $5,000 to every adult if we win,” Trump said and the excerpt of his speech was shared widely online.

One page sharing the video wrote “Trump attempts to bribe people to vote for Republicans in the midterms.”
Trump's $5000 check promise sparks backlash

Several critics were quick to point out that Trump was offering money for votes essentially, ahead of the midterms. “Today Trump tried to buy the midterms by offering all voters a $5,000 bribe in exchange for their votes, provided they spend the cash in the U.S. Since the Fed will have to print the money, the result would be massive inflation, well in excess of anything experienced under Biden,” American stockbroker Peter Schiff noted.

Another remarked “lol. trump openly bribing people to vote for republicans. $5k per person if republicans hold the house and the senate?”. Yet another criticized the president, saying “That's $2 trillion of taxpayers' money in freebies - the Venezuela model. In a real democracy, this is vote-buying, and he would be banned from contesting.”

One person further explained "A sitting US president publicly promised tonight every adult a $5,000 "Trump dividend" if Republicans win full control of Congress, running directly into severe legal and structural barriers. The primary legal threat is 18 U.S.C. § 600, which criminalizes promising government benefits made possible by Congress as a reward for supporting a political party. Tying the money to GOP control fits § 600 far more closely than a standard tax-cut pledge. Vote-buying statutes like 18 U.S.C. § 597 and 52 U.S.C. § 10307(c) also apply."


https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/trump-bribery-vote-buying-5k-dividend-check-offer-at-rnc-meet-ahead-of-midterms-sparks-massive-backlash-101789012172813.html

item.title: [ 39] Got done watching the final episode of Digital Circus this fine morn.
item.description:
I got spoiled on one thing and i came across some vague complaints, found out that apparently it angered a lot of people leading to Gooseworx having meltdowns, but i stayed as spoiler free as possible.
And honestly, i understand those complaints but for me i enjoyed it.
Yeah it could have used more episodes, and certain characters and plot points weren't handled as well as they could have, and there are still questions left unanswered but all in all the final was a chill experience with some good laughs and a satisfying enough ending even with some weird feelings it gives me due to certain decisions made made it was a good sendoff with enough nicely wrapped up and answered.
Overall i give it a good 8/10, especially for someone's first show. A performance a bit questionable but still a joy and a bit comfort to watch despite the uncomfortable elements.
I'll end this off by saying that Gooseworx making Jax his self insert was a mistake, even more so at the very end of the series.
Since I'm late to the party i have been avoiding and ignoring what people had to say, hiding post i knew would be interesting but couldn't read to avoid further spoilers, so i am very interested and excited to read what you guys have to say about Digital Circus' finally.

item.title: [ 74] Charlie Cucked: MIGA fucks up everything, even creating a martyr
item.description:
Charlie Kirk has been transformed into an internet laughing stock, with his legacy destroyed by grifters and his wife.

https://theintercept.com/2026/09/07/charlie-kirk-internet-meme/

In the year since he was gunned down at an event at Utah Valley University, the Turning Point USA founder has gone from a man cut down in his prime to a recurring internet meme, complete with an AI-generated song, “We Are Charlie Kirk,” which hit No. 1 on Spotify’s Viral 50 U.S. ranking. Audio of his killing became a TikTok sound for girlie outfit transformation videos; he’s been inserted into movies like “Avatar” and “The Odyssey”; he’s been AI’d into Studio Ghibli-style art, the final scene of “The Sopranos,” and the video game “Grand Theft Auto.” Even the moment of his death has gotten the meme treatment, with parodies depicting him with Jeffrey Epstein and Benjamin Netanyahu.

The ridicule comes as a product of the American right’s insistence that Kirk’s violent death be taken seriously. They fought back hard against the meme-making and serious critique alike, weaponizing the conservative college-whisperer’s death to broadly crack down on free speech.

President Trump and his allies almost immediately blamed Democrats and “the radical left,” without evidence, for Kirk’s assassination. At the Department of Defense, Secretary Pete Hegseth promised to investigate whether members of the armed forces were inadequately mournful and terminate them. The State Department revoked visas of noncitizens who “celebrated” Kirk’s death. Local cops got in on the civil rights-bashing fun, too: A Tennessee man was arrested for posting a meme in the wake of Kirk’s death, amid a wave of firings in the state on similarly unstable grounds.

item.title: [ 37] Mamdani releases proof Giuliani, Republicans poisoned NYC after 9/11
item.description:
https://www.the-independent.com/news/world/americas/911-air-quality-report-mamdani-ground-zero-b3046630.html

New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani released more than 170,000 pages of internal records Tuesday that show officials misled people about the safety of the air around Ground Zero after the September 11 terror attacks.

“People got sick because the leaders they trusted lied and told them they were safe to breathe in toxic air,” Mamdani said during a news conference.

The move came just days before the U.S. is set to commemorate the 25th anniversary of the al Qaeda hijackings that killed nearly 3,000 people when passenger planes toppled the World Trade Center’s Twin Towers, damaged the Pentagon and crashed near Shanksville, Pennsylvania.

Comedian and activist Jon Stewart, an outspoken supporter of first responders who were sickened while searching for remains at Ground Zero, also spoke at Mamdani’s City Hall news conference.

“There was poison in the air, and on the ground, and in the window sills, and in your air conditioners, and covering your pets and your clothes, and it stayed there for months,” he said. “Everyone knew. Now it’s very clear that the city knew as well.”

Key findings from the documents, which were reviewed by The New York Times before Tuesday’s announcement, include:

• Asbestos levels in dust samples throughout lower Manhattan exceeded hazardous limits in the days after September 11.

• Asbestos and other contaminants were found above acceptable limits in dust and air in lower Manhattan.

• A November 2011 audit showed levels of the carcinogen benzene were still spiking in the air around the towers’ footprints.

• That audit also showed that the amount of asbestos in the air at the Fresh Kills landfill on Staten Island increased after the attacks.

• A woman who lived in lower Manhattan wrote a letter to the DEP in February that detailed alleged missteps by officials in removing contaminants from in and around her building.

CANFIELD, Ohio (WOIO) - An armed Canfield man was arrested Sunday at the Canfield Fair after lunging at Ohio gubernatorial candidate Dr. Amy Acton and injuring multiple people, according to campaign officials and sheriff’s deputies.

item.title: [ 85] Fuel prices at record Labor Day high in US thanks to trump's failing Iran War
item.description:
https://apnews.com/article/labor-day-record-high-gas-prices-dffb7d3fa06ef930aaeebc380e5e4e0e

It’s never been more expensive in the U.S. to fill up the tank and take one last summer trip over the Labor Day weekend.

The average price of regular gas was $4.14 a gallon heading into the holiday, nearly a dollar higher than last year and well above the Labor Day weekend record of $3.82 from 2012, according to AAA motor club.

Nicole Collins planned to head from Philadelphia to South Carolina to visit friends, but she said her family has spent most of the summer close to home and not taking their typical weekend trips because driving has gotten so expensive.

“Gas is pretty high right now. It doesn’t help that we also have a baby, so we also have to pay for that,” Collins said outside a gas station in Claymont, Delaware, where regular gas was $4.199 a gallon.

Prices shot up after the U.S. and Israel attacked Iran in February and have not settled down since. Crude oil traffic through the key Strait of Hormuz has plunged, and Iran has refused to reopen the waterway.

“Everything points to the Iran War and the Strait of Hormuz,” said Tom Seng, a professor of energy finance at Texas Christian University.

Energy Secretary Chris Wright offered few specifics on when the nation’s drivers might see relief at the gas pump, acknowledging that prices are higher now than Labor Day 2025.

But diesel is a different story: It hit a national average of $5.85 a gallon Friday, a record.

Trucks and other freight delivery systems use a lot of diesel, and that increased transportation cost is being passed on to consumers, whether at the grocery store or through package delivery services.

“It doesn’t really seem like there’s an end to it,” Collins said.

Former Pentagon AI Policy Director Mark Beall warned that expanding artificial intelligence surveillance tools, like Flock cameras, could turn American communities into a “China-like surveillance state” unless guardrails are enforced.

Speaking on “Saturday in America,” Beall argued that while this technology can have vital law enforcement benefits, clear rules and judicial oversight are necessary to protect the rights of Americans at home.

“We have to be careful that we don’t go too far to the other direction and create a China-like surveillance state, which is literally what AI capabilities will ultimately enable and are enabling right now,” Beall told Fox News.

From destroyed camera poles to viral signs blocking surveillance lenses, some communities are pushing back against neighborhood surveillance cameras. Flock cameras are automated license plate readers used by law enforcement to record vehicle data that can aid criminal investigations. People in communities with the cameras have raised concerns about privacy and potential misuse by law enforcement.

Beall acknowledged that the technology can benefit law enforcement but said people’s privacy concerns are also valid. He urged a compromise and called for guardrails on how the cameras can be used, including strict rules and court oversight to prevent officers from abusing the technology for personal reasons.

“It’s tough to bring the message of compromise to the American people, especially when it comes to our constitutional protections,” Beall said.

item.title: [275] /out/ings with a pipe
item.description:
Last thread >>2856593

This is a thread for enjoying a pipe while doing outdoor activities. If you ask why this belongs on /out/, you've never spent
an evening by the campfire with a pipe silently enjoying the nature around you, and you're missing out.

>how to get started
Purchase a corn cob pipe (or a cheap briar pipe) and a pouch of Half and Half or Captain Black tobacco from a smoke shop
or online. You will need a lighter or match, and something to tamp it with--a large nail works well if you don't have a pipe tool.
Fill the pipe with tobacco, pack it down halfway, top it off, pack it down to 3/4, top it off again, pack gently and enjoy. Smoke
slower than you think you need to, the tobacco tastes best when it is burning cool. Tamp and re-light as needed. If you still
have trouble, try different methods on YouTube until you find one that works for you.
>smoking a pipe will give you cancer
Originally the Surgeon General found that pipe and cigar smokers, following a careful study of the statistics (at a time when
most adults smoked, so they had a good sample size), had insignificant death rate increases. Nowadays, tobacco is being
legislated against while hard drugs are being legalized. Put two and two together. Tobacco is just another good thing under attack by the government.

>muh weed
Not the time or place. Start your own thread.

All tobacco users welcome.
